text: The stable-lad at the carriage door
why: ¶169 says one of the stable-lads held the carriage door open; the label only describes him.

text: Thursday evening, stepping into the carriage, Holmes turns to a stable-lad
why: They set out Thursday morning and reached Tavistock in the evening. The night-express departure confirms it is still Thursday evening when Holmes touches the lad's sleeve.
